text:
eva: Hey, hitting a 403 'billing_required' on my first run of the node sample app. No prod key yet. Anyone seen this?

eva: Steps I ran:
1) git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples.git
2) cd samples/node-quickstart && npm install
3) export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_live_... (I thought)
4) node index.js

eva: error:
```
HTTP 403: billing_required: workspace not enabled for paid usage
```

sam (devex): Are you using the sample that ships with REDWOOD_KEY env var? We had two variants floating around and that bit caused confusion last week.

eva: I used the repo link in the quickstart — the example reads process.env.REDWOOD_KEY. I set REDWOOD_API_KEY and the SDK still 403s.

sam (devex): The current SDK will prefer REDWOOD_KEY if set, then REDWOOD_API_KEY. But a 403 here is about workspace billing state, not env vars. @alex (billing) can you check whether eva-ws-23 is gated?

ci-bot: New signup eva@acme.com created workspace: eva-ws-23

alex (billing): I see eva-ws-23 in pending-billing state (no payment method / trial not started). That will return billing_required on calls. I'm DMing a trial-enroll link.

jules (eng): Also FYI: SDK retry policy treats 403 as terminal (no retries). 429 and transient network errors are retried. For first-run DX it's helpful to show a specific hint for billing_required.

eva: Is there a quick local workaround so I can run my prototype without adding a card?

nicole (accounts): You can start the free dev trial from the console: https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/eva-ws-23/billing -> "Start trial". I can also issue a short-term promo key if needed — DM me the workspace id.

sam (devex): Action items: I'll update the quickstart README to mention both env var names and add a startup check that surfaces a friendly link when we detect billing_required. Also we'll tweak the SDK error message to include "console.redwood.ai/workspaces/<id>/billing".

eva: Thanks — I couldn't find that billing path in the old nav, so the link helps. Ping me when PR lands.

sam (devex): Filed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — adds env var note and a clearer error for billing_required.

eva: Verified — accepted trial, retried index.js and first call now returns 200. First successful call! :tada:

sam (devex): Great — closing this thread. We'll follow up to remove the REDWOOD_KEY ambiguity from the sample app and improve the SDK error text. :thumbsup:
